duplicate_check.notes: Exact repository searches for MEXC, mexc.com, MEXC Earn, Savings and Simple Earn returned no CYA canonical or staging identity match before allocation. Exact search found no prior use of cya_candidate_000108. The hardened full-corpus candidate scanner remains authoritative before canonical promotion.

notes: Current first-party MEXC sources directly establish a live Earn service. MEXC describes Flexible Savings, Fixed Savings and On-Chain Earn, with Auto-Earn for selected idle Spot assets. The current Earn agreement states that MEXC users deposit/stake/allocate digital assets for fixed or flexible terms to generate returns; Flexible Savings can be redeemed on demand, Fixed Savings locks assets until term expiry, and On-Chain Earn routes opportunities through third-party DApps/protocols. The agreement identifies the contracting party only as MEXC Global and the broader User Agreement as MEXC Trading Platform; reviewed public terms do not establish a single operator incorporation jurisdiction, so use Global rather than infer Seychelles or another country. The agreement explicitly says APR/APY and possible returns are estimates and not guaranteed, while On-Chain Earn adds third-party protocol, smart-contract, network and redemption-timing risk. Jurisdiction access is restricted and changes over time; preserve restrictions as service-availability context rather than country_of_origin. The Feb 4, 2026 hourly-interest upgrade and Feb 27, 2026 delisting of selected savings products show active product maintenance, not platform failure. Any current headline APR shown on the Earn page is dynamic issuer-advertised data, not verified realized customer return.
